description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Shindroid, Magitek Unit and Anomaly alternate racial traits

Benefit: You are actually a Yuke, a formless soul inhabiting a suit of armor, rather than a mechanical being. You gain the Yuke subtype and take no penalty on mind-affecting effects, emotion effects, or fear effects. You may choose to lose your +2 bonus to Intelligence and gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom. In addition, you gain 1 additional MP and, if you have no levels in a casting class, you gain a caster level of 1.

system.requirements: Shindroid, Magitek Unit and Anomaly alternate racial traits
